description: This file defines the class ApiCallAttemptMonitoringMiddleware within the Aws\ClientSideMonitoring namespace. It implements middleware for monitoring API call attempts in AWS SDK, extracting data from requests, responses, and exceptions to facilitate monitoring and debugging.

classes.name: ApiCallAttemptMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for monitoring AWS SDK API call attempts, including request and response data extraction, and error handling.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Factory method for creating middleware with CSM options.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Extracts request data such as FQDN from the request object.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Extracts response or exception data into a structured array for monitoring.

methods.name: populateRequestEventData
methods.description: Populates event data with request-specific details, marking the event type as 'ApiCallAttempt'.

methods.name: populateResultEventData
methods.description: Populates event data with result or exception details, including credentials and attempt latency.

methods.name: getResultAttemptLatency
methods.description: Calculates the latency of an attempt from a result object.

methods.name: getResultDestinationIp
methods.description: Retrieves the destination IP from a result object.

methods.name: getResultDnsLatency
methods.description: Calculates DNS lookup latency from a result object.

methods.name: getResultHttpStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP status code from a result object.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionAttemptLatency
methods.description: Calculates attempt latency from an AwsException.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionErrorCode
methods.description: Retrieves the error code from an AwsException.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the error message from an AwsException.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionDestinationIp
methods.description: Retrieves the destination IP address from an AwsException.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionDnsLatency
methods.description: Calculates DNS latency from an AwsException.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionHttpStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP status code from the response embedded in an AwsException.

methods.name: getExceptionHttpStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP status code from a generic Exception.

methods.name: getExceptionCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifying the type of exception.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message from a generic exception.
